pages.text: Native item storage, a 32,000 mB tank, and a 1,000,000 FE buffer. Nearby same-channel crystals connect automatically. Opening it shows only its own items.$(br2)Apply Moon then Star Attunements in place. Contents survive upgrades and breaking.

Seed: $(bold)16,384$() item-capacity units.$(br)Moon: $(bold)262,144$().$(br)Star: $(bold)4,194,304$().$(br2)An ordinary item costs one unit; an unstackable tool costs 64. Fluid and FE limits do not change with stage.
pages.title: Storage stages

pages.text: Right-click the placed Storage Crystal with the next attunement. Moon comes before Star. Successful upgrades consume the attunement in survival.$(br2)Filled crystals cannot be nested inside Astral storage.
pages.title: Upgrade in place
